image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a cooked Dungeness crab served on a white plate. The crab's carapace is reddish-orange with some darker mottling, typical of cooked crustaceans. Several legs and claws are visible, appearing disjointed or broken, consistent with a prepared meal. A metal crab cracker tool rests in the foreground. The lighting is warm and artificial.

artifact_observations.location: Right side of the crab body/legs
artifact_observations.reasoning: The anatomy on the right side appears somewhat fused and indistinct. While this could be due to the crab being cooked/broken, the boundaries between the leg segments and the body are unnaturally soft and 'mushy', lacking the crisp edges of a real photograph.
The metal tool has a slightly plastic-like sheen rather than a realistic metallic reflection. The hinge mechanism is vague and lacks precise mechanical detail.
The curvature of the plate rim seems inconsistent with the perspective of the table surface, suggesting slight geometric warping common in AI generation.
